vectorstore.provider.description: Initializes a Pinecone adapter and registers it by module name for use by vector step types. Milvus support is planned but not yet implemented.

provider.description: Backend provider. Currently only 'pinecone' is supported (milvus is planned but not yet implemented).

api_key.description: API key for authenticating with the vector database service.

environment.description: Environment name (used by legacy Pinecone environments).

host.description: Custom host URL for self-hosted or private-link endpoints.

namespace.description: Default namespace for all vector operations in this module instance.

index_name.description: Default index name for operations that do not specify one explicitly.

step.vector_upsert.description: Upsert vectors (with IDs, values, and metadata) into the configured vector store index.

module.description: Name of the vectorstore.provider module instance to use.

vectors.description: Array of vector objects, each with 'id' (string), 'values' ([]float), and optional 'metadata' (map).

step.vector_query.description: Perform a similarity search and return the top-K nearest matches.

module.description: Name of the vectorstore.provider module instance to use.

vector.description: The query vector (array of float values) to search with.

top_k.description: Maximum number of results to return.

filter.description: Optional metadata filter map to narrow the search.

step.vector_fetch.description: Fetch vectors by their IDs from the vector store.

module.description: Name of the vectorstore.provider module instance to use.

ids.description: List of vector IDs to fetch.

step.vector_delete.description: Delete vectors by IDs or by a metadata filter. Exactly one of 'ids' or 'filter' must be provided.

module.description: Name of the vectorstore.provider module instance to use.

ids.description: List of vector IDs to delete. Mutually exclusive with 'filter'.

filter.description: Metadata filter for bulk deletion. Mutually exclusive with 'ids'.

deleted_count.description: Number of vectors deleted (set when deleting by IDs).

deleted_by_filter.description: True when deletion was performed by metadata filter.

step.vector_create_index.description: Create a new vector index in the configured vector store.

module.description: Name of the vectorstore.provider module instance to use.

name.description: Name of the index to create.

dimension.description: Vector dimension (must match your embedding model's output size).

created.description: Name of the newly created index.

step.vector_list_indexes.description: List all vector indexes available in the configured vector store.

module.description: Name of the vectorstore.provider module instance to use.

indexes.description: List of index descriptors, each with 'name', 'dimension', 'metric', and 'vector_count'.

step.vector_describe_index.description: Describe an existing vector index, returning its dimension, metric, and vector count.

module.description: Name of the vectorstore.provider module instance to use.

name.description: Name of the index to describe.

metric.description: Distance metric used by the index.

vector_count.description: Total number of vectors stored in the index.
